title: constitution plan-gate deviation report (deviation.json)
description: The per-plan report the plan-gate skill writes and `constitution deviation validate` checks (adr-sourced-constitution.md §8b, implementation-plan.md §2.9). SARIF-shaped, using Spec-Kit's severity vocabulary so a future GitHub code-scanning / Spec-Kit adapter is a thin mapping. Every deviation cites the ADR id it would violate — the citation is the governance primitive. This schema is the structural contract only; the CLI additionally checks that each adrId matches an ADR in the live log, that the summary counts tally, and (advisory) that constitutionHash still matches constitution/constitution.md.

generatedAt.description: When the gate ran (ISO-8601 recommended, e.g. 2026-07-03T14:02:00Z). Free-form string; not machine-parsed in v1.

constitutionHash.description: The sha256 of constitution/constitution.md the gate reasoned over, as "sha256:<64-hex>" (a bare 64-hex digest is also accepted). Lets a consumer detect a stale report: if it no longer matches the on-disk projection, the constitution changed since the gate ran. May be empty in a draft; the validator then reports the expected value as an advisory.

plan.description: The plan the gate evaluated: a file path or an opaque reference.

deviations.description: Every place the plan conflicts with an active rule (empty when the plan conforms). Includes deviations folded in from `constitution guard` violations.

id.description: A within-report identifier for this deviation, e.g. D-001. Unique within the report.

adrId.description: The id of the active ADR this deviation cites, e.g. ADR-0007. Required on every deviation and must match an ADR in the live log.

rule.description: The cited ADR's title (the rule heading as rendered in constitution.md), for human readability.

summary.description: One-line explanation of how the plan conflicts with the cited rule.

recommendation.description: conform = change the plan to obey the rule; amend = the rule is wrong for this case, propose an ADR to change it (under the consent policy).

recommendationDetail.description: Optional prose expanding on the recommendation.

file.description: The plan file (or artifact) the deviation was found in.

lines.description: Optional line span within the file, e.g. "12-40" or "27".
